title: Pro-etale direct image is left exact
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes and $A$ a commutative ring, and let $f_*:\Sh(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)\to\Sh(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ be the direct image of sheaves of modules on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-proetale-module-direct-image]. Then $f_*$ is additive and left exact: for every exact sequence $0\to F'\to F\to F''$ in $\Sh(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ the sequence $0\to f_*F'\to f_*F\to f_*F''$ is exact in $\Sh(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$.

proof.text: Addition of module-sheaf morphisms is sectionwise. The direct image of [def-weil-proetale-module-direct-image] applies each component at the base-changed object and restricts scalars through the coefficient ring map. Consequently f_*(a+b)=f_*a+f_*b componentwise. In Lean the Additive.map_add field follows by extensionality on objects and sections, then reflexivity.

Let R_X and R_Y be the underlying RingCat-valued constant ring sheaves used in [def-weil-proetale-module-direct-image]. After composing the direct image with SheafOfModules.toSheaf R_Y, its functor is definitionally equal to SheafOfModules.toSheaf R_X followed by the continuous sheaf pushforward of abelian groups along proEtaleBaseChange f. Mathlib proves finite-limit preservation for both factors: module-sheaf limits and sheaf limits are computed on underlying sections. Hence their composite preserves finite limits.

The functor SheafOfModules.toSheaf R_Y reflects isomorphisms and preserves finite limits, and the module-sheaf category has finite limits. Thus it reflects finite limits (Mathlib reflectsFiniteLimits_of_reflectsIsomorphisms). Apply preservesFiniteLimits_of_reflects_of_preserves to the composite in the preceding step. This gives finite-limit preservation of f_* itself, which together with the first step proves the conjunction in the Lean statement.
